encoding.heights: one string per row, two hex digits per tile: the tile's height level
encoding.owners: one string per row, one character per tile: company 0-9 then a-e, T town, N none, W water, D deity, '.' not ownable (house, industry, void)
encoding.types: one string per row (y), one character per tile (x): C clear, R railway, r road, H house, T trees, S station, W water, V void, I industry, B bridge or tunnel, O object
